svg.title: What is inside an OSME bag: five layers, exploded
svg.desc: Tag and string, seal, outer filter, temperature membrane, leaf. The membrane pores stay closed in hot water, open at 80 degrees C and close again below 70 degrees C (Sencha). The principle exists: lab membranes already open and close with temperature. Our R&D makes it food-safe at 70-90 degrees C.
svg.text: FIVE LAYERS. ONE OF THEM READS THE WATER.
lab membranes already open and close with temperature. Our R&D makes it food-safe at 70-90 °C.
